node.data.pick.name: Pick array or dictionary item
node.data.pick.description: Select one array item or dictionary key-value pair by its zero-based Index. Preserve values and types, including null. Empty collections, fractional or out-of-range indices fail. Dictionary order is not guaranteed.
node.data.randomPick.name: RandomPick array or dictionary item
node.data.randomPick.description: Choose one array item or dictionary key-value pair uniformly when executed. Duplicate array values remain separate candidates; repeated executions may choose the same item. Empty collections fail.
node.math.random.name: Random number
node.math.random.description: Generate one number when executed. Integers include both bounds; decimals exclude the upper bound. Equal bounds return that value. Repeated executions may return the same number.
Integers include both bounds. Decimals u: Integers include both bounds. Decimals use finite binary64 values and exclude the upper bound unless both bounds are equal.
Inclusive lower bound. Integer mode requ: Inclusive lower bound. Integer mode requires an exact signed 64-bit integer.
Upper bound, at least the minimum. Integ: Upper bound, at least the minimum. Integer mode includes this bound; decimal mode excludes it. Equal bounds return that value.
